Рабочее дерево чистое, кроме четырёх нужных файлов. Публикую.

```json
{"version":1,"taskId":"f40347ef-5d08-4e0a-98f2-85b5767cbfa9","commandId":"publish-1","operation":"publish","headSha":"fa6ee5f21306772e461e99b5ad5f8c4a194eef68","message":"Cup recess and themed flag in HoleSceneBuilder

The cup was a flat dark disc: no flag, no depth. buildCup now returns one
cup assembly group with the mouth marker, a back-faced liner sunk by the
capture depth, a floor disc, a flag pole and a pennant whose cloth colour
comes from the course theme. Geometry and material caches are shared as
before (an open-ended cylinder and a unit triangle join them) and both are
disposed by the builder; result.dispose also clears the nested group.

The theme id reaches the builder through HoleRuntime, which Game passes
course.themeId. Keeping the parts in a child group leaves the hole mesh
count unchanged. Tests cover the recess, the flag placement and colour,
the default-colour fallback and the per-colour material cache."}
```
